scope: RAVE: rituximab versus daily cyclophosphamide for induction of remission in ANCA-associated vasculitis.

keyRecommendations.text: Rituximab 375 mg/m2 weekly for 4 weeks was noninferior to cyclophosphamide 2 mg/kg/day for prednisone-free remission at 6 months.
keyRecommendations.population: ANCA-positive Wegener granulomatosis or microscopic polyangiitis

keyRecommendations.text: 64% of the rituximab group and 53% of the control group reached the primary end point (noninferiority P<0.001).
Rituximab was more efficacious than cyclophosphamide for relapsing disease.

clinicalBottomLine: In RAVE, rituximab was noninferior to cyclophosphamide for steroid-free remission at 6 months and better than cyclophosphamide for relapsing disease.
notableCaveats: RITUXVAS numbers are not in this paper and are not asked. Adverse-event rates did not differ significantly.
